visual_brief.subject: Anthropic adds a first-party Claude API route through Google Cloud projects
verified_context: Anthropic launched an Anthropic-operated Claude API route reached through a Google Cloud project.
Google Cloud IAM controls access and Google Cloud Marketplace handles billing while Anthropic remains the API operator.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Separate identity and procurement gateways from the independently operated model service.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: two gateways sharing one identity checkpoint before an independent terracotta service chamber
must_show: two gateways sharing one identity checkpoint before an independent terracotta service chamber

candidate_notes.A: Selected: the paired entry routes, shared checkpoint and distinct service chamber communicate the operator boundary without brand marks.
candidate_notes.B: The cloud pavilions are dramatic, but the identity-versus-operator distinction is less immediate.
candidate_notes.C: The three-part landscape is accurate as a metaphor but the marketplace colonnade weakens the single focal idea.

crop_review.article_desktop: Both entry routes, the checkpoint and the service chamber fit within the wide composition.
crop_review.article_mobile: The checkpoint and independent chamber remain visible in the center-right crop.
crop_review.thumbnail: The paired routes converging at the checkpoint remain distinct.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared with the two declared repository references for warm paper texture, restrained stone materiality, sparing terracotta emphasis, physical depth and thumbnail legibility. Candidate A was selected after full-size and small-size visual inspection.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Three candidates generated per story. Candidate A was inspected at full size and thumbnail scale; cover-crop safety and prohibited elements were reviewed by Codex model self-review. Candidate C for the Rescale story was rejected for pseudo-text-like paper marks.
